subject: Re: Kickoff: memorization audit for our LMs — readout decisions
body:
Team,

Ahead of Friday's readout, decisions and the headline:

- The June sweep completed on the reserved week. Our models show the same three log-linear relationships as the public study — capacity, duplication, context length — and our largest model emits verbatim continuations for 38% of examples duplicated 10+ times at 200-token prompts. That number alone justifies the audit.
- Decision 1: the audit becomes a standing pre-launch requirement; Bilal's tooling gets a runbook and an owner in the platform org next quarter. Kofi's approved-template path worked, so the privacy SLA is no longer on the critical path for future runs.
- Decision 2: dedup mitigation (dropping 10+ duplicated examples from future pretraining) goes into Q3 planning as a corpus-team ask, with our duplication counts as the evidence base.

Thanks all — Friday is mostly a victory lap.

Priya
